description: Package classification and complete allowed dependency edges for the local clone family libraries under crates/. Authority: gwz-dev dev-docs/GwzLocalCloneLibraryBoundaries.md revision 1 (§2 packages/roles/edges, §4 owners, §6 gate), adopting LBT-001..LBT-012 of the canonical Library Boundary and Testing Policy. Changing a role, an edge or an allowlist is a policy change that goes through lane C with the affected lane's review, never a routine way to make the gate green (LBT-012).

roles.contract: Public behavior and boundary data; named traits with meaningful required operations; no concrete implementation dependency.
roles.pure: Deterministic transformation or state machine; explicit input/output contract; no I/O.
roles.implementation: A replaceable service or algorithm implementing a named contract and running its conformance suite.
roles.integration: Composition and orchestration through narrow injected ports; documented concrete dependencies.
roles.harness: Development tooling; outside every production dependency path; dev-dependency only.

gwz-copy-contract.rationale: Tree-copy request/result/error/cancellation and the TreeCopier port; a useful substitution boundary between installation and the platform copier.

gwz-repo-contract.rationale: Repository observations, typed object ids, RepoInspector and bounded ObjectReader ports; separates every consumer from the Git implementation.

gwz-repo-inspect.rationale: Local Git/filesystem reads implement the repository contracts.

gwz-work-detector.rationale: Classifies supplied observations and decoded evidence; no I/O, so no port is needed.

gwz-history-check.rationale: Bounded traversal through an injected read-only ObjectReader; no deletion or fetch.

gwz-family-model.rationale: Family data, row transitions, names and remote-token resolution; deterministic values, no trait needed.

gwz-family-store-contract.rationale: Read view, locked session and family metadata mutation port over the small pure model.

gwz-family-store.rationale: YAML index, ordinary publication and OS advisory locking implement the store contract.

gwz-local-import.rationale: Pairing, capture, retained imports and push through its own narrow LocalTransport port.

gwz-workspace-install.rationale: Copy/construction/install ordering via injected ports; consumes construction and configuration ports rather than concrete siblings.

gwz-repo-factory.rationale: Bare/clean construction through its own repository-builder port.

gwz-local-disposal.rationale: Fresh safety observations and one-shot removal through ports; consumes a history-check port rather than the concrete verifier.

gwz-local-testrepo.rationale: Tiny real Git/temporary-tree fixtures for real-I/O adapter tests; dev-only, never a production dependency of any crate.
